short_description: Validate paid orders, allocate stock, pick and pack items, dispatch parcels, and send tracking updates.

questions.question: Which channels create orders and where do new orders first appear?
What checks happen before an order is released for fulfilment?
options: None — paid orders print straight into packing

questions.question: How do staff know which location or warehouse should fulfil the order?
options: System routing rule by stock or postcode
Manager checks stock spreadsheets and assigns manually

questions.question: How are picking lists created and how are picked items checked against the order?
options: Barcode scan verification against order system
Printed packing slips checked visually by packer
Staff read orders straight from screen/phone with no formal double-check

questions.question: Who packs, labels and hands the parcel to the carrier?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Fulfilment assistant packs, prints shipping label manually, and hands to courier...

questions.question: How is dispatch confirmation and tracking information sent to the customer?
options: Triggered automatically when label is generated or scanned
Staff copy tracking numbers manually into storefront or emails
Only sent if the customer asks

questions.question: What happens when stock is unavailable, an address is wrong, payment is held or dispatch fails?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Order sits aside in an exception tray while customer support emails the buyer...

short_description: Monitor stock levels, calculate reorder quantities, issue supplier POs, inspect goods, and update inventory.

questions.question: How do you currently know which items need replenishment?
options: Automated low-stock alerts from inventory system
Weekly manual review of sales vs stock spreadsheet
Warehouse staff notice shelves running low or items go out of stock

questions.question: Are reorder points or minimum stock levels defined, and who maintains them?
options: Yes — defined per SKU and reviewed regularly by ops/buyer
Rough mental rules or outdated minimums in a spreadsheet

questions.question: How do you check demand, lead time and available cash before ordering?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Operations lead checks 30-day sales history and asks finance/owner if budget is available...

questions.question: Who selects or approves suppliers and purchase quantities?
options: Buyer raises PO; owner/finance approves before sending
Owner handles both selection and ordering directly
Inventory coordinator reorders approved SKUs up to a threshold

questions.question: How are deliveries checked against the order and discrepancies recorded?
options: Counted against purchase order with discrepancy log sent to supplier
Quick visual check against packing slip; variances noted casually
Boxes put straight on shelves without formal count

questions.question: When is received stock made available for sale, and who updates the stock record?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Warehouse assistant updates stock count in storefront the same day or next morning...

questions.question: How do you handle damaged, short, excess or slow-moving stock?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Damaged units quarantined and emailed to supplier; slow movers discounted ad hoc...

short_description: Approve return requests, inspect inbound parcels, decide disposition, and reconcile refunds and inventory.

questions.question: How does a customer request a return and what information is captured?
options: Self-service returns portal collecting order ID, item, reason, and photos
Customer emails or messages support with order details
Items simply arrive back in the post with a paper note

questions.question: Who checks eligibility against the returns policy?
options: Customer service agent checks order date & policy manually

questions.question: What exceptions require a manager's decision?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Late returns past 30 days, high-value claims, damaged without photos...

questions.question: How is the returned item received and inspected, and who records its condition?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Warehouse packer opens parcel, inspects condition, and messages support on Slack...

questions.question: Who decides whether it is restocked, repaired, written off or exchanged?
options: Warehouse staff using written grading rules
Warehouse asks manager or founder case by case
No fixed grading — usually put back on shelf if unopened

questions.question: Who authorises and processes the refund or replacement?
options: Finance / manager must approve all refunds

questions.question: How are inventory, payment records and customer updates reconciled after resolution?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Storefront restocks SKU on refund, though damaged stock adjustments happen manually later...

short_description: Consolidate customer tickets across channels, investigate order issues, resolve complaints, and log recurring themes.

questions.question: Which channels receive customer questions and complaints?
What details are needed to identify the order and understand the issue?
options: Often missing — support has to ask back and forth

questions.question: How are enquiries prioritised and assigned to the right person?
options: Tagged and routed automatically in helpdesk
Team lead triages inbox manually each morning
Whoever logs in picks up messages from each separate app

questions.question: What response-time expectations exist for different types of enquiry?
options: Clear response targets by urgency (e.g. same-day for missing orders)
General aim to reply within 24 hours, no formal tiers

questions.question: Which issues can frontline staff resolve and which require approval?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Staff can resend small orders under £30; full refunds or carrier disputes need manager sign-off...

questions.question: How is the resolution and customer communication recorded?
options: Central ticket thread linked to order profile
Notes spread across email, social DMs, and warehouse chats

questions.question: How do you identify repeat complaints or recurring product/delivery issues?
options: Monthly review of ticket tags and defect reasons
Team notices patterns informally when several complaints hit
